title: Active Preference Learning over Latent Preference Archetypes for Many-Objective Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2603.28410v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Preference-based many-objective Bayesian optimization typically assumes that all pairwise comparisons arise from a single latent utility function, despite real decision makers often exhibiting multiple latent preference archetypes across contexts. We propose an active preference learning framework for many-objective Bayesian optimization that infers latent preference archetypes from pairwise comparisons, enabling both the identification of the active trade-off strategy and the refinement of its associated preferences. Our framework represents preferences as a Dirichlet-process mixture of latent archetypes and introduces mixture-aware information-theoretic query strategies that separately target archetype identification and within-archetype refinement through a hybrid acquisition policy. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world chemical process design case-study consistently outperforms state-of-the-art preference-based Baye

translated_title: 面向多目标贝叶斯优化的潜在偏好原型主动偏好学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于偏好的多目标贝叶斯优化通常假设所有成对比较都源于单一的潜在效用函数，尽管真实决策者在不同情境下往往表现出多种潜在偏好原型。我们提出了一种面向多目标贝叶斯优化的主动偏好学习框架，该框架从成对比较中推断潜在偏好原型，从而能够识别活跃的权衡策略并优化其相关偏好。我们的框架将偏好表示为潜在原型的狄利克雷过程混合模型，并引入了混合感知的信息论查询策略，通过混合采集策略分别针对原型识别和原型内细化进行优化。在合成基准测试和真实化工过程设计案例研究上的实验一致优于最先进的基于偏好的贝叶斯优化方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多目标贝叶斯优化框架，通过狄利克雷过程混合模型推断多个潜在偏好原型，并采用混合信息论查询策略同时实现原型识别和偏好细化，从而在合成与真实化工设计中优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a many-objective Bayesian optimization framework that infers multiple latent preference archetypes via a Dirichlet-process mixture model and uses a hybrid information-theoretic acquisition strategy for joint archetype identification and preference refinement, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on synthetic and real-world chemical process design benchmarks.
